primaryOutcomeMeasures.title: Pharmacokinetics Parameter : Skin Flux of INCB018424

primaryOutcomeMeasures.description: The INCB018424 bioavailability will be estimated from the overall mean steady-state plasma concentrations for each subject in this study and the estimated systemic clearance of INCB018424 following oral-dose administration in another study. Bioavailability is defined as the proportion of a drug which enters the circulation when introduced into the body and so is able to have an active effect.
